title: Keep experimental estimators out of module __all__ to prevent wildcard import errors
answers: Why does 'from sklearn.model_selection import *' raise an ImportError?
How to support type checking for experimental estimators without breaking wildcard imports?
Should experimental estimators like HalvingGridSearchCV be included in __all__?
body:
Symptom: from sklearn.model_selection import * fails with ImportError.
Root cause: sklearn/model_selection/__init__.py:__all__ included experimental estimators that raise ImportError prior to explicit enablement.
Fix pattern: Remove experimental estimators from __all__ while keeping them under if typing.TYPE_CHECKING: with # noqa: F401.
Constraints: Applies to experimental estimators that require explicit enable_* imports; standard public estimators must remain in __all__.
applies: Public scikit-learn subpackages with experimental estimators requiring activation imports.
